offlineOracleHardening.negativeControl: A window containing an unclassified outgoing connection fails; the otherwise identical quiet window passes. Genuine zero network traffic is not forced to generate traffic merely to satisfy a count.
offlineOracleHardening.attribution: Artifacts distinguish attributable report requests, background requests, and requests without frame attribution. Loopback host traffic is permitted and not attributed to report code; service-worker attribution and syscall capture semantics remain explicit limits.
offlineOracleHardening.restrictedHistory: The test exercises the designer's expected restriction once, requires the exact refusal and unchanged bytes, then invokes Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+S through the source editor after checking the active document tab and text-editor status. Profile artifacts distinguish this source-editor route from trusted designer history. Fixture setup isolation is never counted as Undo proof.
offlineOracleHardening.limitation: Pure/source-level oracle checks do not prove actual Linux capture, trust journeys or zero report-triggered activity.

contrastOracleSelfChecks.assertions: Low-contrast text with a high-contrast decoy fails; independently known 4.5:1 and 7:1 pairs measure correctly; boundary bands follow computed widths and reject decoys; malformed/truncated PNGs throw.
contrastOracleSelfChecks.glyphNegativeControl: A low-contrast glyph with a black decoy cannot certify the icon requirement. An unproven paint fails even when its supplementary farthest-color diagnostic exceeds 20:1; a proven low-contrast paint also fails. Proven 7:1 paint passes the pure control.
contrastOracleSelfChecks.pngScanlineCorrection: A parent regression constructs a PNG with a valid complete container but insufficient decompressed bytes for its declared width. The old decoder silently supplied black pixels; the decoder now checks the exact decompressed scanline length before reading. All five contrast tests pass after the correction.
contrastOracleSelfChecks.limitation: Synthetic oracle checks are not actual Desktop contrast measurements. Actual icon paint, 200-percent variants and genuine reference screenshots remain open.
